verses.text: The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.
lines: The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, speaks,
and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.

verses.text: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.
lines: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty,
God shines out.

verses.text: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.
lines: Our God comes, and does not keep silent.
A fire devours before him.
It is very stormy around him.

verses.text: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:
lines: He calls to the heavens above,
to the earth, that he may judge his people:

verses.text: “Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”
lines: “Gather my saints together to me,
those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”

verses.text: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge.
lines: The heavens shall declare his righteousness,
for God himself is judge.

verses.text: “Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.
lines: “Hear, my people, and I will speak.
Israel, I will testify against you.
I am God, your God.

verses.text: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.
lines: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices.
Your burnt offerings are continually before me.

verses.text: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.
lines: I have no need for a bull from your stall,
nor male goats from your pens.

verses.text: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.
lines: For every animal of the forest is mine,
and the livestock on a thousand hills.

verses.text: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.
lines: I know all the birds of the mountains.
The wild animals of the field are mine.

verses.text: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.
lines: If I were hungry, I would not tell you,
for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

verses.text: Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
lines: Will I eat the meat of bulls,
or drink the blood of goats?

verses.text: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.
lines: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving.
Pay your vows to the Most High.

verses.text: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”
lines: Call on me in the day of trouble.
I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

verses.text: But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,
lines: But to the wicked God says,
“What right do you have to declare my statutes,
that you have taken my covenant on your lips,

verses.text: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?
lines: since you hate instruction,
and throw my words behind you?

verses.text: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.
lines: When you saw a thief, you consented with him,
and have participated with adulterers.

verses.text: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.
lines: “You give your mouth to evil.
Your tongue frames deceit.

verses.text: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.
lines: You sit and speak against your brother.
You slander your own mother’s son.

verses.text: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.
lines: You have done these things, and I kept silent.
You thought that I was just like you.
I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.

verses.text: “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.
lines: “Now consider this, you who forget God,
lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.

verses.text: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”
lines: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me,
and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”
